$description: Color / Active — neutral mode. All values alias the 'neutral' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to make it neutral-colored. Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'neutral'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for neutral components (e.g. filled button bg, badge bg)

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for neutral-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for neutral-colored components
